recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-6060 unless the work group chooses a broader editorial cleanup of primitive-extension prose outside this historical issue.
issue_request: FHIR-6060 was a Published FHIR-core clarification request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking the Extensibility page to reference the JSON documentation for extensions on simple/primitive datatypes, including the underscore representation and the association of extensions with values when the primitive repeats.
initial_application: Historical commit 2fe4a1880ec2f3ba2ac7df03032a70b9aa234f3f, '#6060 - reference json primitive form from extensibility page', added the note linking source/extensibility.html to json.html#primitive and recorded svn revision 6359, matching the Jira application comment.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini maps the Extension type page to extensibility, confirming the page is in the current build scope. The current source also has a dedicated Extensions on Primitive Datatypes section and the linked JSON primitive section documents extension-only primitive values and null-aligned arrays for repeating primitive values. Zulip and Confluence searches found no directly relevant conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current source already preserves the applied FHIR-6060 behavior and further source edits would only duplicate existing guidance.
